messages:
maria: @channel FinHealth asked for an IAM/access control pack for their vendor review (SIG + CAIQ + a few custom questions). They want: SSO/SAML metadata, MFA enforcement evidence, RBAC role matrix, least-privilege note for service accounts, and a redacted audit log sample. Deadline is Thu EOD. I attached their questionnaire here: https://drive.google.com/finhealth-rfp — can Security + SEs own the artifacts and upload?

alex: I can put together the SAML SP metadata and screenshots of our IdP config (Okta). Will also add a short note confirming Dedicated customers can enforce SSO in Private deployments. Quick Q: do they want the exact Okta screenshots or a sanitized export?

nate: We should provide both policy-level evidence and an event-level sample. Proposed deliverables:
- SAML SP metadata (XML) and recommended IdP claims mapping
- MFA enforcement policy screenshot + policy export (policy id)
- RBAC role mapping CSV (role -> allowed endpoints)
- Example audit log (redacted) showing mfa_verified events
- Short least-privilege statement for service accounts + example terraform snippet
I can redact and upload to a shared drive.

maria: They explicitly asked for CAIQ/SSM-style answers too (checkbox matrix). Can someone confirm whether we have a canned CAIQ export or if we need to map answers manually?

julia: We don't have an automated CAIQ export. I can map the relevant controls from our internal control library and populate the CAIQ template. For the service account scope example, here's the terraform snippet I'll include:

```hcl
resource "redwood_service_account" "inference_reader" {
  name = "inference-readonly"
  roles = ["inference.viewer"]
  allowed_endpoints = ["/v1/generate","/v1/embeddings"]
  denied_endpoints = ["/admin/*","/billing/*"]
}
```

julia: Also adding that service account keys rotate every 30 days by default (KMS-backed).

nate: For MFA enforcement evidence, best combo is: policy screenshot (Org SSO policy -> require MFA), policy export (JSON), and one or two redacted audit events: e.g.,

```json
[{"event":"login","user":"alice@redwood.com","mfa_verified":true,"ts":"2025-07-18T14:12:03Z"}]
```

nate: I'll remove PII and upload everything to a restricted folder and share a view link. Should we also include the RBAC matrix as CSV and as a small human-readable table? Some reviewers prefer CSV.

alex: CSV + short human summary would be ideal. Also: FinHealth wants confirmation that service accounts are least-privilege — include the terraform example and a line that says we regularly run role audits every 30 days and have automated alerts for overly broad permissions.

maria: Great. Action items:
- nate: collect MFA policy export, redact logs, and upload (ETA: Tue)
- julia: CAIQ mapping + terraform snippet and RBAC CSV (ETA: Tue)
- alex: short sales note on Dedicated/Private SSO enforcement + any contract language for account isolation (ETA: Wed)
- maria: coordinate delivery and sign-off with Legal (NDA if requested) (ETA: Thu)

audit-bot: Reminder: when uploading audit logs to shared drive, use the restricted folder template and enable time-limited links.

maria: Thanks team. I'll compile and send the package once uploads are in. If FinHealth asks for live demo of SSO enforcement, we can schedule a 20-min call next week. :thumbsup:
